install.agentRequest: 请先在 deeplugin.store 中检索 Registry ID deeplugin-8151dd028c2ddb9342d5，展示来源和精确安装 spec，为 web profile 生成安装计划；等我明确批准后再安装。

posts.zh:
dsh-voice 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。语音输入、语音输出：把口述音频转写为用户消息（transcribe），让 agent 朗读回复（speak），本地优先，音频存于 ~/.dsh/voice。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8151dd028c2ddb9342d5.html
posts.en:
dsh-voice is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8151dd028c2ddb9342d5.html
